---
title: "codex-stdin-prompt"
description: "Pipe stdin and a prompt to the OpenAI Codex CLI in non-interactive mode"
---

## Overview

`codex-stdin-prompt` mirrors `claude-stdin-prompt` but targets the
[OpenAI Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex).
It pipes stdin with a prompt to `codex exec` in quiet mode and writes the response to stdout.

```bash
git diff --cached | codex-stdin-prompt --model o4-mini -p "Write a commit message"
cat data.csv | codex-stdin-prompt --model gpt-4o "Identify outliers"
```

## Dependencies

- [`codex` CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) on `PATH`
  (`npm install -g @openai/codex`)

## Options

### Wrapper-owned options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-p, --prompt <text\|file>` | Prompt text, or path to a file whose contents are used as the prompt. Also accepted as a bare positional argument. |
| `--context-file <text\|file>` | Context placed before the prompt. Value is read as a file when it points to one, otherwise treated as a literal string. Repeatable. |
| `--custom-verbose` | Stream Codex's full progress output to the terminal instead of suppressing it. |
| `-h, --help` | Show help and exit. |
| `--` | End wrapper parsing; remaining arguments are forwarded to `codex` verbatim. |

### Forwarded options

All other flags are forwarded to `codex` verbatim — `--model`, `--provider`,
`--approval-mode`, etc.

::: {.callout-note}
`--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` is injected automatically so that
Codex does not prompt for tool approvals during text generation tasks.
:::

## Usage

```bash
# Basic — pipe output with a prompt
git diff --cached | codex-stdin-prompt --model o4-mini -p "Write a commit message"

# Read from a file
codex-stdin-prompt --model o4-mini --prompt-file prompts/review.md < diff.patch

# Bare positional prompt
cat data.csv | codex-stdin-prompt --model o4-mini "Identify outliers"

# Stack context blocks
git diff --cached | codex-stdin-prompt \
    --context-file docs/commit-rules.md \
    --context-file "Output in Japanese" \
    -p "Generate a commit message"

# Show full Codex progress stream
cat report.md | codex-stdin-prompt --model o4-mini --custom-verbose -p "Review this"
```

## Notes

- **stdin is mandatory.** Running with a TTY on stdin exits with an error.
- Only the final agent message is printed by default; use `--custom-verbose` to
  see Codex's full progress stream.
